# Capture checklist: Water

<!-- Generated by `node core/bin/capture.ts build` from data/vocab/types.json and core/src/schema/capture/properties.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

R is required for Usable, R? is required when its condition holds, A is applicable (counts for Complete). Properties not listed are never asked. Suitability paths are listed under their profile; the full list for a type is `node core/bin/capture.ts fields --type <id>`.

## Lakes, rivers and coast (`water.body`)

Records: place. Suitability profile `lake` (never, extension water). Effort: none, time is shown. Sources, in order: F O T D X C.

**place**: R name, type, point, area_id, wikidata, summary, best_time, access_points, access_cost, class_key, draw, standing, distinction, easy_payoff, weather, why, signals, links; R? near_town (derived), hours (operates), price (sells), window (bookable), closures (status_page); A names, osm_ref, geonames_id, best_window, transit, pairs_with, photos, part_of, address.

Suitability: R age_band, kid_note, stroller, wheelchair, on_site_min, walk_m, access_season; R when operated none; A carrier_ok, stroller_extent, access_detail, accessible_toilet, accessible_parking, limited_capacity_note, effort.drivers.distance_km, effort.drivers.gain_m, effort.drivers.surface, effort.drivers.loss_m, toilets, food, shade, picnic, exposure, altitude_m, hazards, water_safety.entry, water_safety.water_temp_c, ext.water.swimming.
